bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to labor and industry; directing the commissioner to adopt rules relating to steam boilers.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. RULEMAKING; HIGH PRESSURE BOILERS.

The commissioner of labor and industry shall amend Minnesota Rules, part 5225.1180, to allow low mass high pressure steam boilers to operate in the same manner as low pressure steam boilers.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: The commissioner of labor and industry shall amend Minnesota Rules, part 5225.1180, to allow low mass high pressure steam boilers to operate in the same manner as low pressure steam boilers.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
